name: medieval_pikeman_iso_v3_oblique
notes: Oblique v3 candidate generated to emphasize 45-degree top-down RTS perspective.
This version makes helmet tops, shoulder/back mass, boot placement, and ground-plane footprint more visible than the original v3.
Generated on chroma-key green, normalized to 2048x1024, then converted to alpha PNG.
Still a 2D atlas prototype; spear thrust frames may require hand cleanup if used beyond visual iteration.
